description: Save or update an owned text-only draft or published card using only creative IDs currently enabled in the server MCP card catalog configuration. Cards support a separate optional title and required message and signature. Suggest title and message when appropriate without unnecessary questions. Recipient details are optional for link sharing. Show preview_url for review, then offer publish_ecard or send_ecard. To edit a published card, first get_ecard and supply its current fields with the desired title, message or signature, draft_id and expected_revision. Published edits take effect immediately at the same public URL and require a verified account; show the revised preview afterward. Design and language cannot change. Recipient and scheduling details can change before dispatch. Pending or unresolved email processing blocks edits; after transport submission only title, message and signature can change. Editing never sends another email or changes a previous dispatch receipt.

language.description: Name and site localization only: fr for French, en for any other language. Every design suits every language; message text may use any language.

message.description: Required main message text, separate from the optional title and signature.

title.description: Optional short greeting or heading displayed separately from the main message. Defaults to empty.

name: prepare_ecard
